verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser is an immigration law firm with a dedicated startups practice, so a founder can fairly ask whether its materials cover fallback plans. The evidence shows only general candour that founders must adapt visas meant for other purposes. Nothing documents running the company remotely while waiting, Canadian or other interim options, or what happens after a denial.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider's materials honestly cover the fallbacks — running the company remotely while waiting, Canadian or other interim options, and what happens after a denial
